item.title: Amazon to buy satellite firm Globalstar in $11.57B deal
Barcelona unrest: how to fabricate a protest in the age of TikTok
item.description:
📝 This was the picture that emerged in Barcelona on October 24. The TikTok accounts that spurred these particular protests have since been deleted, along with all of their posts and content. There are common trends across Blocus-linked accounts, which use AI-generated posters with similar slogans and dark images of burning streets across national borders.
🔗 Read more: https://theconversation.com/barcelona-unrest-how-to-fabricate-a-protest-in-the-age-of-tiktok-295263

item.title: About the compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs
item.description:
📝 Remove root CA certificates from /etc/ssl/cert. These steps affect every tool that uses /etc/ssl/cert. To remove root CA certificates from /etc/ssl/cert.
